Hey can you help me out please I had a channel where I had uploaded dance cover and due to copyright it wasn't allowing me to make it public so can I still upload it or I have to leave that video? I was a long video of 3-4 minutes including 2-3 songs I hadn't added extra audio it was a recording of performance but still these things happened please help me out if you can that would be a great help!!❤

Aww 🥺❤️ first of all don’t panic, this happens with sooo many dance cover channels, especially when copyrighted songs are involved 🪷

If YouTube is not allowing the video to be public, it usually means one of these things happened:
1) the copyright owner blocked the song in your country/worldwide. 
2) the combination of multiple songs triggered stricter copyright rules.
3) sometimes long performances get detected even if it’s just background/performance audio.

But no, it does NOT always mean you have to delete the whole video 🫶

You can try these things:
🌷 check the “Restrictions” section in YouTube Studio carefully...
— if it says “Blocked” then sadly that version can’t be public unless you edit it.
— if it says “Copyright claim” only then the video can usually stay up but monetization goes to the owner.

🌷 try trimming/muting the exact copyrighted parts using YouTube Editor. Sometimes even removing a small section fixes the issue ✨

🌷 if there are 2-3 songs together, one specific song might be causing the block. You can test by editing or replacing that section only.

🌷 You can also upload it as Shorts/Reels in smaller parts sometimes those get less strict detection 🪷

And please don’t feel discouraged 💕 dance covers and performance videos get copyrighted VERY easily, even when it’s your own choreography or live performance recording. It happens to so many creators🫶🏻
Hope your video works out soon 🤍✨
